                module,

                nn.GroupNorm(
                    num_groups=_group_count_for_channels(child.num_features),
                    num_channels=child.num_features,

            raise ValueError(f"Expected feature map (B,C,H,W), got {tuple(feature_map.shape)}")

        flat = feature_map.reshape(batch_size, channels, height * width)

        pos_y, pos_x = torch.meshgrid(

            indexing="ij",

        pos_y = pos_y.reshape(1, 1, height * width)
        expected_x = torch.sum(attention * pos_x, dim=-1)
        expected_y = torch.sum(attention * pos_y, dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([expected_x, expected_y], dim=-1)
